query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Enabling cfg_zero_star + use_zero_init (zero_star_steps=0 default) on WanVideoExperimentalArgs crashes on step 0: predict_with_cfg's early-exit branch returns a 2-tuple while all callers unpack 3 values (ValueError) — reproduces on any I2V/T2V graph, v1 and v2 samplers.

desired.outcome: OP fully root-caused it: the use_cfg_zero_star + use_zero_init early-exit in predict_with_cfg (nodes_sampler.py ~line 1172 on main) returns 2 values; fix is returning the 3-tuple from that branch. No maintainer reply, no merged fix at thread end.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: OP fully root-caused it: the use_cfg_zero_star + use_zero_init early-exit in predict_with_cfg (nodes_sampler.py ~line 1172 on main) returns 2 values; fix is returning the 3-tuple from that branch. No maintainer reply, no merged fix at thread end.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Read a multi-return-path sampler function and spot the inconsistent return arity in one early-exit branch (2-tuple vs 3-tuple unpack) — pure code-reading, no model knowledge needed.
